## Learning need

Which concept, level, and practice duration does this address? How does it differ from an existing exercise?

## Contract and examples

Describe the public Python interface and one normal and one edge case. For a correction, identify the current exercise ID and mismatch.

## Content provenance

Is this original work? If adapted, link its source and explain permission to redistribute it. Do not post confidential employer interview questions.

## Validation idea

Which realistic incorrect solutions should fail? Use docs/EXERCISE_TEMPLATE.md for a complete contribution.
